text: Secure at least €15k committed funding for Aimparency by 31 August 2026
description: Success means at least €15,000 is contractually committed to Aimparency by 31 August 2026, not merely an application submitted. Primary path: one or more warm angels using a simple early-stage instrument after legal review, or paid design-partner/sponsorship agreements. Upside path: OpenAI Build Week prize announced around 12 August. Public grants with later decisions remain pipeline, not counted toward this deadline. Preserve optionality between open-source public-interest funding and venture financing until legal/IP structure is decided.

supportingConnections.reflection: Contributed €0: the prize upside path ($10–15k per track) did not materialize — not selected among the Build Week winners (~25 Aug 2026). It did yield a public demo video, Devpost entry and an idea-to-commit provenance feature reusable as application evidence.
Contributed no funding: Felix found he is not eligible (2026-10-16) and turned away from grants altogether. Side effect kept: the scope work pushed the protocol v0 (e207bec5).

supportingConnections.hypothesis: One-month runway requires committed funding or revenue.

status.comment: Felix 2026-10-16: did not happen. No funding was contractually committed by 31 August 2026 (committed meant signed: a grant award, an investment agreement or a paid contract, not revenue earned).
